msg: So, i didnt really notice a pattern...sorry i thought i did but i musnt have. The other pattern i thought i noticed was paying attention to which side the gnomes were on as in if purple was on the left it gave more points if on the right less, this turne dout to not be true. The brown gnome seemed to give me more points  than any other and also the Blue gnome gave me alot halfway through the game.Im sorry i can't be more help i did get almost 4 thousand points but i just couldnt figure out a pattern, good luck!
